name: Ernie
source:
Gang # 6
Color: Yellow
Sin: Gluttony	

At first glance, he seems like the harmless youngest one. Simple, smiley, and always ready to crack a joke and keep the conversation going, Ernie quickly becomes the “heart of the group.” He’s easy to be around. His friendliness disarms you, his humor cuts the tension. He seems genuinely happy to be part of the team and willing to help anyone. But sometimes there’s a flicker in his eyes you’d rather not notice, as though a secret were concealed behind his habit of always being convenient.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4314300/]Steam[/url]]
